hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Partition
hints.text: At split index i (0 <= i < n), the prefix has length i + 1 and the suffix has length n - 1 - i.

hints.title: Integer Averages
hints.text: Prefix average is pref // (i + 1). Suffix average is suff // (n - 1 - i) if n - 1 - i > 0, otherwise 0.

hints.title: Running Sum Maintenance
hints.text: Total sum S allows computing prefix and suffix sums in O(1) at each step: suff = S - pref.

hints.title: Single-Pass Prefix Sum Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumAverageDifference(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        total = sum(nums)
        pref = 0
        min_diff = float("inf")
        best_idx = 0
        for i in range(n):
            pref += nums[i]
            left_avg = pref // (i + 1)
            right_cnt = n - 1 - i
            right_avg = (total - pref) // right_cnt if right_cnt > 0 else 0
            diff = abs(left_avg - right_avg)
            if diff < min_diff:
                min_diff = diff
                best_idx = i
        return best_idx
```

complexity.notes: Single pass after initial total sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing slice averages at each index takes O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles the edge case where suffix has length 0 and properly floors integer division.
